text:
Pavel Mintyukov had the night of his season in Edmonton on Nov. 5: two goals, an assist and a fight for a Gordie Howe hat trick, in a win that kept Anaheim's run going. The Ducks are 5-0 since he rejoined the lineup on Nov. 1, and he's playing about 19 minutes a night.

The 10th pick of the 2022 draft is still a work in progress, and the numbers say so honestly. He has six points in 14 games, but two goals on 1.11 expected and a 16.7% shooting rate won't last for a defenceman with the 5th percentile shot by NHL Edge, and the Ducks have been fortunate with him on the ice. They've also lost the chance battle at five on five with him out there (46.7%). Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level last season, though his chance-based value was better than his goals, and he draws more penalties than he takes. The best thing in his game is the first pass: Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 52% of his exits leaving the zone with possession. Our projection: about 27 points.
